897.flavor: Amante de la quietud y la soledad, galopa por las tinieblas nocturnas absorbiendo la energía vital de toda criatura que esté durmiendo.

898.flavor: Legendario monarca del antiguo Galar. Posee el poder de sanar el espíritu y de hacer brotar la vegetación.

899.flavor: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

900.flavor: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

901.flavor: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

902.flavor: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

903.flavor: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

904.flavor: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

905.flavor: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

906.flavor: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

907.flavor: The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on the Pokémon’s mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.

908.flavor: With skillful misdirection, it rigs foes with pollen-packed flower bombs. Meowscarada sets off the bombs before its foes realize what’s going on.

909.flavor: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco’s head and flickers to and fro.

910.flavor: The valve in Crocalor’s flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.

911.flavor: Skeledirge’s gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

912.flavor: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

913.flavor: The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.

914.flavor: Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.

915.flavor: This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.

916.flavor: It entrances female Pokémon with the sweet, alluring scent that wafts from all over its body.

917.flavor: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread’s strength is the topic of ongoing research.

918.flavor: Spidops covers its territory in tough, sticky threads to set up traps for intruders.

919.flavor: It’s highly skilled at a fighting style in which it uses its jumping capabilities to dodge incoming attacks while also dealing damage to opponents.

920.flavor: It uses its normally folded third set of legs when in Showdown Mode. This places a huge burden on its body, so it can’t stay in this mode for long.

921.flavor: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

922.flavor: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

923.flavor: Pawmot’s fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

924.flavor: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

925.flavor: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

926.flavor: The yeast in Fidough’s breath is useful for cooking, so this Pokémon has been protected by people since long ago.

927.flavor: The surface of this Pokémon’s skin hardens when exposed to intense heat, and its body has an appetizing aroma.

928.flavor: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.

929.flavor: It basks in the sun to its heart’s content until the fruits on its head ripen. After that, Dolliv departs from human settlements and goes on a journey.

930.flavor: This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.

931.flavor: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they’re out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

932.flavor: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli’s body.

933.flavor: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.

934.flavor: Many Pokémon gather around Garganacl, hoping to lick at its mineral-rich salt.

935.flavor: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

936.flavor: This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by psychic and fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs.

937.flavor: An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused this Pokémon’s evolution. Ceruledge cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.

938.flavor: It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.

939.flavor: What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs for discharging the electricity generated by Bellibolt’s belly-button dynamo.

940.flavor: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy.

941.flavor: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There’s hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

942.flavor: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

943.flavor: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

944.flavor: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.

945.flavor: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.

946.flavor: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.

947.flavor: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.

948.flavor: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

949.flavor: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

950.flavor: This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps opponents’ attacks, then lunges for their weak spots with its claws.

951.flavor: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

952.flavor: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

953.flavor: It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.

954.flavor: An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.

955.flavor: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.

956.flavor: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.

957.flavor: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it’s satisfied with the result.

958.flavor: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other’s hammers by smashing them together.

959.flavor: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

960.flavor: Though it looks like Diglett, Wiglett is an entirely different species. The resemblance seems to be a coincidental result of environmental adaptation.
